Descriptions.ShortDescription: Pushes NINA equipment & sequence metadata to Focale and uploads captured FITS frames automatically.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
Bridges N.I.N.A. to Focale (https://focale.space).

Two integrations:

1. Metadata sync — event-driven JSON snapshots of the active equipment profile, the running sequencer tree, target list, device runtime state, and observatory/site info are pushed to Focale on profile changes, device connect/disconnect, sequence start/finish, slews and filter changes.

2. Automatic FITS upload — every successfully saved FITS frame (with its full ImageMetaData) is uploaded to Focale in the background via a durable on-disk queue that survives network drops and app restarts.

Privacy: API key is stored DPAPI-encrypted at rest. Known secret-bearing fields (Astrometry/PinPoint API keys, anything matching Password/ApiKey/Token/Secret/Credential) are redacted before any payload is sent. Both upload and metadata sync have their own toggle.
